record.bible_text: So these three<WH07969> men<WH0582> ceased<WH07673><WTH8799> to answer<WH06030><WTH8800> Job<WH0347>, because he <FI>was<Fi> righteous<WH06662> in his own eyes<WH05869>. <RF>to...: Heb. from answering<Rf>

Also against his three<WH07969> friends<WH07453> was his wrath<WH0639> kindled<WH02734><WTH8804>, because they had found<WH04672><WTH8804> no answer<WH04617>, and <FI>yet<Fi> had condemned<WH07561><WTH8686> Job<WH0347>.

Now Elihu<WH0453> had waited<WH02442><WTH8765> till Job<WH0347> had spoken<WH01697>, because they <FI>were<Fi> elder<WH02205><WH03117> than he. <RF>waited...: Heb. expected Job in words<Rf> <RF>elder: Heb. elder for days<Rf>

When Elihu<WH0453> saw<WH07200><WTH8799> that <FI>there was<Fi> no answer<WH04617> in the mouth<WH06310> of <FI>these<Fi> three<WH07969> men<WH0582>, then his wrath<WH0639> was kindled<WH02734><WTH8799>.<CM>

And Elihu<WH0453> the son<WH01121> of Barachel<WH01292> the Buzite<WH0940> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I <FI>am<Fi> young<WH06810><WH03117>, and ye <FI>are<Fi> very old<WH03453>; wherefore I was afraid<WH02119><WTH8804>, and durst<WH03372><WTH8799> not shew<WH02331><WTH8763> you mine opinion<WH01843>. <RF>young: Heb. few of days<Rf> <RF>durst...: Heb. feared<Rf>
I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Days<WH03117> should speak<WH01696><WTH8762>, and multitude<WH07230> of years<WH08141> should teach<WH03045><WTH8686> wisdom<WH02451>.
But<WH0403> <FI>there is<Fi> a spirit<WH07307> in man<WH0582>: and the inspiration<WH05397> of the Almighty<WH07706> giveth them understanding<WH0995><WTH8799>.
Great men<WH07227> are not <FI>always<Fi> wise<WH02449><WTH8799>: neither do the aged<WH02205> understand<WH0995><WTH8799> judgment<WH04941>.
Therefore I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Hearken<WH08085><WTH8798> to me; I also will shew<WH02331><WTH8762> mine opinion<WH01843>.

Behold, I waited<WH03176><WTH8689> for your words<WH01697>; I gave ear<WH0238><WTH8686> to your reasons<WH08394>, whilst ye searched out<WH02713><WTH8799> what to say<WH04405>. <RF>reasons: Heb. understandings<Rf> <RF>what...: Heb. words<Rf>
Yea, I attended<WH0995><WTH8709> unto you, and, behold, <FI>there was<Fi> none of you that convinced<WH03198><WTH8688> Job<WH0347>, <FI>or<Fi> that answered<WH06030><WTH8802> his words<WH0561>:
Lest ye should say<WH0559><WTH8799>, We have found out<WH04672><WTH8804> wisdom<WH02451>: God<WH0410> thrusteth him down<WH05086><WTH8799>, not man<WH0376>.
Now he hath not directed<WH06186><WTH8804> <FI>his<Fi> words<WH04405> against me: neither will I answer<WH07725><WTH8686> him with your speeches<WH0561>. <RF>directed: or, ordered<Rf><CM>
They were amazed<WH02865><WTH8804>, they answered<WH06030><WTH8804> no more: they left off<WH06275><WTH8689> speaking<WH04405>. <RF>left...: Heb. removed speeches from themselves<Rf>
When I had waited<WH03176><WTH8689>, (for they spake<WH01696><WTH8762> not, but stood still<WH05975><WTH8804>, <FI>and<Fi> answered<WH06030><WTH8804> no more;)
<FI> I said<Fi> , I will answer<WH06030><WTH8799> also my part<WH02506>, I also will shew<WH02331><WTH8762> mine opinion<WH01843>.
For I am full<WH04390><WTH8804> of matter<WH04405>, the spirit<WH07307> within<WH0990> me constraineth<WH06693><WTH8689> me. <RF>matter: Heb. words<Rf> <RF>spirit...: Heb. spirit of my belly<Rf>

Behold, my belly<WH0990> <FI>is<Fi> as wine<WH03196> <FI>which<Fi> hath no vent<WH06605><WTH8735>; it is ready to burst<WH01234><WTH8735> like new<WH02319> bottles<WH0178>. <RF>hath...: Heb. is not opened<Rf>
I will speak<WH01696><WTH8762>, that I may be refreshed<WH07304><WTH8799>: I will open<WH06605><WTH8799> my lips<WH08193> and answer<WH06030><WTH8799>. <RF>be...: Heb. breathe<Rf>
Let me not, I pray you, accept<WH05375><WTH8799> any man's<WH0376> person<WH06440>, neither let me give flattering titles<WH03655><WTH8762> unto man<WH0120>.
For I know<WH03045><WTH8804> not to give flattering titles<WH03655><WTH8762>; <FI>in so doing<Fi> my maker<WH06213><WTH8802> would soon<WH04592> take me away<WH05375><WTH8799>.<CM>
